key_insight: Memory volume should be tuned to the model: stronger agents can benefit from all guidelines, while weaker agents may perform better with a small selected subset.
engineering_relevance: Deploy agent memory with model-specific selection and evaluation rather than assuming more remembered guidance always improves performance.
method: Mine 1–3 short lessons per episode from the agent’s own trajectories.
Consolidate lessons into guidelines, recording how many lessons each guideline merges.
Provide all guidelines or a selected subset at inference.
evidence_signal: On AppWorld, DeepSeek-V3.2 gained 9.5 percentage points in task completion with all 191 guidelines; gpt-oss-120b rose from 39.9% to 51.2% with all 199 guidelines and to 55.4% with about 29 selected guidelines, averaged over two runs.
watch_item: Audit guideline quality, provenance, API failures, and baseline comparability: frequent guidance can backfire, and plausible logs can conceal complete task failure.
paper_title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
